name: HKDFExpand
description: Performs the Expand phase of HKDF to derive key material from a PRK. Use after HKDFExtract.
syntax: HKDFExpand( string algorithm, any prk, any info, numeric outputLength )

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Hash algorithm: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512

params.name: info
params.description: Context/application info (can be empty string or null)
